data.name: Aarav
data.gender_notes: Aarav is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Often derived from the Sanskrit root rav, 'sound', or linked to śānti, 'peace'. The 'peaceful' sense is a modern popular gloss. Its root is Sanskrit śrāv / rav. A modern popular Indian given name. Aarav is a Sanskrit name meaning “Peaceful; calm; (also) sound”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aarav expresses “Peaceful; calm; (also) sound”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Often derived from the Sanskrit root rav, 'sound', or linked to śānti, 'peace'. The 'peaceful' sense is a modern popular gloss.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aarav total 16, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
